name: sloopDX
intro: SLOOP's live four-track groovebox with a real DX7 inside: three six-operator FM synths plus FM drums; ALGORITHM picks the track, PRESETS the voice, REC records.

rows.what: Back to the TRACKS screen.
Pick the track: 1-3 DX7 synths, 4 FM drums.
Tempo, on almost every page (not in the DX7 voice list).
LFO pages; tap again for the next page (ENV likewise).
Lock a held layer open; any other button closes it.
Settings menu: SCREEN, LIGHTS, AUDIO, SYSTEM; OCT- closes it.
The track's sound: DX7 voices, your bank, user presets; drums: kit.
Octave down; both OCT buttons together: back to 0.
Drum track: ghost hit (OCT+: hard hit).
Set the song's key for all synths.
One-key chords: TRIAD, 7TH, 9TH, SUS4, POWER.
Note repeat / drum roll; KNOB 1 sets its rate.
Arp mode; OMNI makes the keys a chord harp.
Synth track: the DX7 voice list. Drum track: the drum screen.
Voice list: SELECT picks a row, ALGORITHM sets its value.
Voice list: open OP1-OP6, Pitch Env, LFO; HOME goes back.
Voice list: jump straight to the next / previous operator.
Voice list: low-pass CUT (KNOB 2 RESO, 3 REL, 4 FDBK).
Voice list: store your voice edits into the DX7 bank.
On TRACKS: level of the selected track (KNOB 4 pan).
Level of track 1 (KNOB 2-4: tracks 2-4).
Start / stop all four tracks.
Playing: record now, on top. Stopped: arm, first note starts.
Empty song: play freely, REC on the next 1 closes the loop.
Hold 2 seconds: clear the selected track.
Undo (OCT+: redo).
Set or clear steps 1-16 (drums: the sound on KNOB 1).
Pattern length up to 128 (KNOB 2 step size, KNOB 3 swing).
Erase that note or drum sound from the loop.
Mute tracks 1-4 (keys 5-8: solo).
Tap tempo.
Punch-in effect while held (loops, stutter, reverse...).
More punch-ins: kills, rewind, freeze, fade out...
Master DJ filter (KNOB 2 dust, KNOB 3 duck).
Reverb throw while held (OCT+: echo throw).
Track sends; tap again: DIST, CHORUS, DELAY, REVERB, SLICER, INSERT.
Save the loop as section A-D (used: press twice).
Play section A-D (on the next bar if playing).
On TRACKS: song screen; elsewhere: presets and section pages.
Drum kit or sound page: store your kit as MY KIT.
USB rescue mode: reinstall from the web installer.
Hardware calibration: teach each button and knob.
Stopped, 5 seconds: update mode (UBOOT) for the installer.

keys.label: Drums: same sound as white key to the left

tips: Every synth track is a real DX7: 6 operators, 32 algorithms, Dexed's engine; at CUT 127 a patch sounds as on a DX7.
PRESETS runs through 20 factory voices (EPIANO, FM BASS, BRASS...), then the 32 voices of your DX7 bank, then user presets.
Load your own DX7 banks (.syx, 32 voices) in the web editor: 8 banks fit in flash; the voice list's Bank row picks one.
Drums are FM too: kits DX KIT, 808 FM, ELECTRO, METAL and MY KIT. On the drum sound page the key you play picks the sound, KNOB 1-4 = TUNE, DECAY, SWEEP, BRIGHT.
Every function button is a layer: hold it and the keys and knobs change job; a short tap opens its pages.
Patterns go up to 128 steps: hold SEQ and tap OCT- / OCT+ for the 16-step pages.
MIDI: tap GLO and tap again for MIDI, MIDI 2, MIDI 3 (a channel per track, clock); GLO + black key 1 = MIDI LEARN.
Autosave: stop and leave it 2.5 s; it comes back as you left it at power-on.
checked: Ref 872ff07 = the 4.0 release commit ('4.0: from SLOOP 2.6 / 2.7 ...'); no v4.0 tag. ui.c FELUCCA_VERSION 'sloopDX 4.0'; FM-1_940 comes from tools/build.py --release 4.0 (PRODUCT FM-1_9XY), as docs/webapp/installer meta at eeec0a6 says. No firmware change between 872ff07 and eeec0a6.

ui_input.c ui_input: HOME hold 0.7 s (btn_hold) -> menu, tap -> go_home (ui.c: FELUCCA_ARRANGER=1 -> TRACKS page); ALGORITHM -> track_select on every page (not in a take); SELECT -> G_BPM always (page_walk in ui.c is never called); PRESETS -> preset_go / drum kit on TRACKS, PRESETS page; OCT-/OCT+ octave -3..+3, both = 0, not on drum track; ENV/LFO open_family (same button again: next page).
ui_input.c tracks_edit: TRACKS KNOB 1 SWING, 2 LEVEL, 3 LEN, 4 PAN.

ui_input.c layers_input: layer + HOME tap = lock, other buttons (not PLAY/REC/OCT) unlock; EDIT + OCT-/OCT+ undo/redo; SEQ + OCT-/OCT+ step page; FX + OCT- / OCT+ = thr_req bit 0 / 1, ui_layers.c sub line 'rev throw' / 'echo throw'.

ui_input.c layer_tap: FX -> FAM_FX; EDIT on voice page -> voice_tap, on TRACKS with drum track -> studio_open(SC_DRUM), else FAM_EDIT (first page 'DX7' SC_VOICE in params.c); SAVE -> ve_store on voice page, SONG on TRACKS, drum_save_tap on drum page, else FAM_SAVE; ARP -> FAM_ARP; GLO -> FAM_GLO.

ui_input.c holds_input: REC press = rec_toggle; held 0.7 s + HOLD_CLEAR_MS 1300 (ui_layers.c) clears the track. ui_studio.c rec_toggle comment: playing = record at once, stopped = arm, empty project = free take closed by REC.

ui_layers.c layer_key: SEQ white keys step_down/up (drum: pen_lane), black keys pages; SEL any key -> P_ROOT of all synth parts; SAVE w 0-3 play/load A-D, 4-7 store (again within 3 s if used); GLO black key k==1 (F#3) ml_toggle, white 1-4 mute, 5-8 solo, 16 tap_tempo.

ui_layers.c layer_knobs: FX K1 G_FILT, K2 DUST, K3 DUCK (no K4 track filter in sloopDX); ARP K1 G_ROLL; SEQ K1 note/lane, K2 SDIV, K3 SSWING, K4 SLEN (NSTEP, 256 shared); SEL K1 CHORD (N_CHORD OFF TRIAD 7TH 9TH SUS4 POWER), K2 SCALE, K3 KEYS, K4 TRANS; GLO K1-3 track level, K4 G_DRLVL.

seq.c key_down: FX -> punch_fx_of_key (white 0-15, black 16-26; punch.c PUNCH_NAME 27 names); EDIT -> erase (drum + black key toggles live mute mode); ARP -> roll_start; key_lvl OCT- ghost / OCT+ hard. AM_OMNI: black keys chords (OMNI_ROOT).

ui_voice.c voice_screen_input: SELECT row, ALGORITHM value (Bank row: dx_bank_select of 8), PRESETS next/previous operator, HOME back to top / go_home, KNOB 1-2 CUT/RESO (P_E6/P_E7), 3-4 home_param = DX7 macro[2..3] = P_E4 REL, P_E5 FDBK (eng_dx7.c ENG_DX7 macro {E1 BRITE, E2 ATK, E4 REL, E5 FDBK}). VR_TOP rows OP1-OP6, Pitch Env, LFO, Name, Copy To, Init Voice, Store, More Pages.

eng_dx7.c DX7_PRESETS: 20 factory voices, CUT default 127. drums.c DRUM_KIT_NAMES DX KIT, 808 FM, ELECTRO, METAL, MY KIT; LANE_NAME order + key_of_lane (F G A B C D E per octave) -> white key indices 0,2,4,6,7,9,11,12,14,16,18,19,21,23,24,26; lane_of_key: black key = white key to its left; DM_DESC tune decay sweep bright noise level pan choke rev.

ui_studio.c: drum_edit_tap GRID -> KIT -> LANE; drum_save_tap KIT/LANE: SAVE twice -> ukit_bake MY KIT; drum_screen_input LANE page: key played picks drum_lane, KNOB 1-4 macros by dm_pg, PRESETS macro page.

params.c PAGES: FX family SENDS, DIST, CHORUS, DELAY, REVERB, SLICER, INSERT, INSERT 2; GLO family GLOBAL, MASTER, SYSTEM, DRUMS, MIDI, MIDI 2, MIDI 3, TEXTURE; N_AMODE OFF + 16 modes incl. OMNI, FLW.

main.c: OCT- + OCT+ at power-on -> panel_setup; OCT- + OCT+ held 5 s stopped -> UBOOT; recovery.c recovery_key -> bootguard_manual: OCT- alone. ui_menu.c: OCT- closes, ABOUT OCT+ twice FACTORY RESET. project.c AUTOSAVE_IDLE 2500 ms.
unsure: Which drum screen page (GRID / KIT / LANE) tapping EDIT opens first: drum_page is kept between visits (static, starts at GRID), so the row stays generic.
Voice-list KNOB 3 / 4 = REL / FDBK read from home_param + ENG_DX7 macro; README only says '3 and 4 as on HOME'.
SEL + key: code accepts any of the 27 keys (black too); written as white keys to match the format.

MIDI (per-track channels, MIDI 2/3, clock out) and TEXTURE not checked row by row; only mentioned in a tip. 4.0 itself was not yet played on a device per README status (TODO at eeec0a6 says installed, load test clean).
Manual: used the repo's SLOOP.md (README calls it 'the full manual'); https://dx7.designburgapps.com is the installer/site.
